ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels (approx. 75%) contrasted against high-intensity white localized clusters (approx. 25%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white punctate clusters are concentrated on the distal and lateral lobe regions, while the perimedial region near the notch consists of solid low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 65 degrees and deep penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with irregular saw-tooth peaks and valleys extracted along the entire horizontal boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex sweep trajectory along the posterior margins, tapering to upwardly curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular and annular white pixel clusters (rosettes) ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter across 80% of the visible surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint linear high-contrast pixel disruptions; parallel diagonal marks on the upper-left lobe and vertical rake-like marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized brownish-yellow textured pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating physical encrustation or trauma.
